title: Selena Gomez and Tate McRae Bring the Magic to Ulta Beauty’s Holiday Campaign
description: Ulta Beauty’s holiday campaign features Selena Gomez and Tate McRae, whose brands are both sold at the retailer.

title: Agents Prompt People: Using Agents for Long-Horizon Financial Work
description: Arca's head of AI discusses persistent memory, the benefits of a custom harness, and agentic workflows that span days.

title: Apple CEO says the company doesn’t ‘want to ship AI for AI’s sake’
description: Apple's new CEO defended the company's current position in the AI landscape.

title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
description: An NAACP lawsuit accuses the SpaceX-owned AI company of violating the Clean Air Act.

title: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
description: OpenAI’s latest funding round doesn't seem to be living up to expectations.

title: Amex nabs new risk chief
description: The executive shuffle comes at a pivotal time for Amex, which was hit this month with regulator penalties over anti-money laundering compliance failures.

title: AI agents won’t pay the way you do
description: Plaid’s payments head explains how payment methods might shift as artificial intelligence begins choosing how to pay.

title: Gemini Carbon aims to boost AI cyber defense, but is limited to a few
description: The model addresses security concerns. Yet its exclusive release means most enterprises won’t be able to test it.

title: Prompt: AI demand is booming; the economics are getting complicated
description: Anthropic’s IPO filing offers a glimpse into soaring enterprise AI demand, but price competition and the cost of delivering AI are complicating the path to profitability.

title: Anthropic IPO puts enterprise AI returns in focus
description: The SEC filing reveals the scale of the vendor’s commercial growth while raising a broader question of how enterprise buyers can tell if AI spending is paying off.

title: Anthropic IPO filing offers clues for enterprise AI, model price wars
description: With the frontier AI lab about to go public, businesses mull the long-term stability of the Claude creator. OpenAI goes on a price-cut binge to compete with cheap China models.

title: Google’s AI overhaul of search hits snags as ad revenue growth cools
description: The rate of ad revenue growth decelerated in Q3 for Google’s core business despite a jump in query volume driven by AI features.

title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
description: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
description: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

title: Profound vs. Peec AI: Which is right for your team?
description: Profound and Peec AI are two of the most frequently compared tools in the AEO category right now, and the decision isn’t so straightforward. The two platforms take different approaches to data collection, pricing, and what happens after you read a visibility score.
